title: Turgent
summary: TUR'GENT, adjective [Latin turgens, form turgeo, to swell.] Swelling; tumid; rising into a tumor or puffy state; as when the humors are turgent

inlines.v: TUR'GENT, adjective [Latin turgens, form turgeo, to swell.] Swelling; tumid; rising into a tumor or puffy state; as when the humors are turgent
